title: Dynamo v1.6.0
text:
Dynamo v1.6.0 - Release Notes
Dynamo v1.6.0 is the 19th feature release of the open-source distributed inference platform, spanning 654 merged PRs from 148 contributors. Dynamo Router gains pluggable flow control: request classifiers can defer, reorder, or steer requests, and every selection path now runs on one shared core with scoring knobs consolidated into one policy file. On Kubernetes, LPX brings LPU-backed inference to DynamoGraphDeployments, multinode components take role-specific pod templates, and Dynamo Snapshot backs engine failover. Dynamo Planner reconfigures GPU budgets at runtime, and the engines move to SGLang v0.5.21, TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0rc29, and vLLM v0.31.0.
Summary
Dynamo Router: Pluggable Flow Control & Unified Selection
Dynamo Router opens request intake to plugins. A request-classifier hook lets a plugin defer a request, override validated scheduling inputs, or suggest a worker without overriding explicit worker pins (#14123, #14177). Every request now flows through the policy queue, which orders requests by deadline (#14176). ThunderAgent ships as a builtin plugin (#15164). Dynamo Frontend, the standalone selection service, and the Gateway API endpoint picker (EPP) now share one worker-selection core (#14570). Scoring knobs move into --router-policy-config, and the older flags are deprecated (#15202). An opt-in session prefix index tracks session-to-block lineage for agentic workloads (#13807), and a versioned gRPC relay exposes KV pool state to consumers outside the data center (#14379).
Dynamo Frontend: Structured Parsing, Reranking & Error Fidelity
Dynamo Frontend adds opt-in V2 tool and reasoning parsers for eight model families, selected with DYN_PARSER_VERSION (#14950), with structural tags on by default for supported parsers (#15916). DeepSeek V4.1 gains reasoning and tool-call support (#15030). An OpenAI-compatible /v1/rerank endpoint serves SGLang cross-encoder models (#14032), and a root-level thinking_token_budget field caps reasoning tokens on SGLang and vLLM (#12624, #15120). Errors map to protocol-correct OpenAI and Anthropic responses (#14396, #14002). The Frontend HTTP server now supports mutual TLS (#14173).
Multimodal & Omni: Video-Aware Routing & New Speech Models
Video-aware KV routing extends from vLLM to SGLang for Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5 (#15014), and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni gains exact image and video routing (#14564, #14653). vLLM-Omni adds Nemotron Audex text-to-speech (#12788) and MiniMax-H3 text-to-video-and-audio generation (#13589, #14702). External encoders can reuse Dynamo's image extraction and prompt reconstruction through a public handoff API (#13293). An opt-in shared cache of encoded images in Redis Cluster or Dragonfly saves repeated media fetches (#14676).
Kubernetes: LPX, Role Pod Templates & Snapshot Failover
LPX components bring LPU-backed inference to DynamoGraphDeployments, with partition selection for hybrid builds and rolling build updates on Grove (#15062, #15563, #15607). Multinode worker, prefill, and decode components can take separate leader and worker pod templates (#14468), and the Operator injects portable DYNAMO_RANK and DYNAMO_LEADER_ADDRESS variables (#15374). Dynamo Snapshot backs active and standby engine failover for SGLang and vLLM (#15924) and captures CUDA shared memory by default (#15791). The GPU Memory Service adds Intel XPU support (#12484). The Rust Endpoint Picker scales past one replica (#14758), and GA Helm charts publish to the NGC OCI registry (#13657).
Dynamo Planner & Performance Modeling
Dynamo Planner reconfigures endpoint floors and GPU budget bounds at runtime through /v1/min-endpoints (#14218, #14231), caps how many replicas one throughput decision changes (#14296), and keeps pending capacity when demand falls while a worker is still starting (#14671). An experimental Planner Gym compares Planner, KEDA-style, reactive, and static autoscaling policies against replayed or live traffic (#15576). Performance-model consumers across the Planner, Profiler, Router, Frontend, Mocker, and replay move to AISimulate's canonical configuration (#15063). Replay gains typed agentic traces (#13586), Codex and Claude trace export (#15601), and host-memory KV offload in the Mocker (#15647).
Observability & Transport
Dynamo and engine metrics can export over OTLP to an OpenTelemetry Collector (#14071), and opt-in lifecycle tracing models each request from arrival to completion (#14101). The runtime warns on sustained Tokio queue pressure (#13027). An opt-in batched QUIC response plane joins the default TCP path (#11996), and IPv6-only fixes cover listeners, ZMQ, SGLang KV events, and vLLM multinode (#15383).

Dynamo Special Interest Groups (SIGs)
Dynamo now has six Special Interest Groups (SIGs). Each SIG runs a public meeting, reviews the Dynamo Enhancement Proposals (DEPs) and PRs in its area, and sets that area's roadmap. Anyone in the community can join, bring a PR or DEP, and be involved in the technical direction of Dynamo.
#sig-router: KV-aware routing, Global Router, and Gateway API routing.
#sig-engines: SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, TokenSpeed, and Dynamo Sidecar.
#sig-frontend: Frontend APIs, tool calling, and parsers.
#sig-deploy: Kubernetes Operator, Helm charts, DRA, and Grove.
#sig-agents: Agentic inference, agent hints, and request tracing.
#sig-rl: RL integration, rollouts, and weight updates.

Breaking Changes
Notable Behavioral Changes
Kubernetes and Operator
vLLM worker services use short names (VllmWorker / VllmPrefillWorker / VllmDecodeWorker -> worker / prefill / decode), matching the SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and Mocker backends and keeping generated names under Grove's 45-character limit (#9848).
Migrate: Update DynamoGraphDeployment manifests, overrides, scripts, dashboards, and alerts that reference the old vLLM service names. Pod names, Kubernetes Service names, and the dynamo_component metric label change with them.
Dynamo Operator no longer adopts resources it does not own (#13990). An existing object that shares a name with an Operator-managed child but has no controller owner, or a different one, is no longer adopted, updated, or deleted; the deployment reports an ownership conflict instead.
Migrate: Before upgrading, delete or rename any pre-existing Deployments, Services, or other objects that collide by name with Operator-managed children.
Multinode settings are validated more strictly (#14468, #14533). multinode is accepted only on worker, prefill, and decode components, roles[] takes at most two entries, and a declared role must carry a complete PodTemplate that owns its launch command.
Migrate: Remove multinode from frontend, Planner, EPP, and other non-engine components, trim each roles list to a leader and a worker, and give every declared role a full PodTemplate.
Init container named runtime is reserved (#14927). Declaring it with restartPolicy: Always switches the component into Dynamo native sidecar mode, and the runtime version then resolves from that container's image.
Migrate: Rename any unrelated init container called runtime before upgrading. In sidecar mode, make sure the runtime image carries a semantic-version tag or set runtimeVersionOverride.
Grove v0.1.0-alpha.14 is required for new multinode deployments created by Dynamo Operator v1.6.0, and the Operator now owns the DYNAMO_RANK and DYNAMO_LEADER_ADDRESS environment variables on those components (#15374, #15704). Existing deployments keep their current environment and command lines.
Migrate: Upgrade an externally managed Grove and its CRDs to v0.1.0-alpha.14 before creating new multinode deployments, and rename any user-defined DYNAMO_RANK or DYNAMO_LEADER_ADDRESS variables in component pod templates.
Grove Coherent updates are opt-in (#15903). Without the nvidia.com/grove-update-strategy: Coherent annotation, every DynamoGraphDeployment uses Grove's RollingRecreate default.
Migrate: Set the nvidia.com/grove-update-strategy: Coherent annotation on deployments that should keep coherent rollouts.
Operator-managed namespace discovery is strict for Dynamo v1.6.0 runtimes (#15561). A frontend in deployment foo no longer discovers workers from deployment foo-bar; it still admits foo, its foo-<8 hex> worker generations, and foo-legacy.
Migrate: If you relied on discovery across deployments that share a name prefix, rename the deployments or set DYN_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_STRICT=false on the affected frontend and EPP containers.
GB200 nodes report GPU SKU gb200 instead of gb200_sxm (#15711).
Migrate: Update automation and profiling configuration that reads the Operator-populated gpuSku for GB200 nodes.
Snapshot enables CUDA shared-memory capture by default (#15791). Automatic checkpoint jobs set nvidia.com/cuda-shared-memory-support: enabled, the checkpoint target container must set command, existing checkpoints are recaptured once because the compatibility hash now includes the annotation, and snapshot mode no longer forces the NCCL and TensorRT-LLM zero-copy variables off.
Migrate: Add an explicit command to the checkpoint target container, or set nvidia.com/cuda-shared-memory-support: disabled on the DynamoGraphDeployment to keep the previous behavior. Set NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE, NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE, or TLLM_NCCL_SYMMETRIC_ZERO_COPY to 0 yourself if you depended on snapshot mode disabling them.
The platform chart blocks the Dynamo Operator update when an externally managed Grove is incompatible or still rolling out (#16891). A preflight Job checks the Grove controller before the Operator installs or upgrades, and it pulls docker.io/library/python:3.12-slim by default.
Migrate: Upgrade the external Grove controller and its CRDs to v0.1.0-alpha.14 before upgrading the platform chart, and override dynamo-operator.grovePreflight.image for internal registries. Set dynamo-operator.grovePreflight.enabled=false only when a separate compatibility gate exists.
Frontend and API
Remaining OpenAI routes return JSON errors (#14002). Malformed requests to embeddings, image generation and edits, and audio now receive the standard JSON error envelope instead of a plain-text body.
Migrate: Update clients that parse plain-text error bodies from these endpoints.
Non-streaming /v1/responses no longer infers tool calls from assistant text (#14846). Only structured tool calls from the backend become function-call output items; <tool_call> markup in plain text stays text.
Migrate: Enable a tool-call parser on the backend (for example --dyn-tool-call-parser hermes) so tool calls arrive structured.
Forced tool choice wins over response_format on SGLang (#14179). tool_choice="required" or a named tool now constrains output to a tool call, and requests that cannot satisfy a forced tool choice, such as required with no tools, are rejected.
Migrate: Send a non-empty tools array with tool_choice="required", and use tool_choice="auto" when response_format should shape the output.
Boundary-only reasoning parsers fail at startup with the vLLM chat processor (#14991). Parsers such as openai_gptoss previously started and then failed each request with HTTP 500.
Migrate: Remove or replace boundary-only reasoning parsers when using --dyn-chat-processor vllm.
Anthropic billing preambles are stripped by default (#15826). The x-anthropic-billing-header preamble that Claude Code adds is removed from requests unless disabled, reducing tokens and prompt-cache variation.
Migrate: Set DYN_STRIP_ANTHROPIC_PREAMBLE=0 or pass --no-strip-anthropic-preamble to keep preambles intact.
Structural tags are on by default for supported parsers (#15916). DYN_ENABLE_STRUCTURAL_TAG now defaults to true and DYN_STRUCTURAL_TAG_SCOPE to always, so valid tool schemas that use constructs the grammar backend rejects, such as regex lookahead, can fail requests.
Migrate: Set DYN_ENABLE_STRUCTURAL_TAG=false if your tool schemas use constructs the grammar backend rejects.
/v1/models/<model>/ready returns 503 for a known but unready model (#16943). It previously returned HTTP 200 with ready: false. The diagnostic JSON body is unchanged.
Migrate: Parse the JSON body on both 200 and 503 responses in diagnostic clients, and treat 503 as unready and retry.
Router and Planner
Dynamo Router policy YAML takes precedence over scoring flags (#15202). Parameters under worker_selection.instances[].parameters in --router-policy-config override the deprecated command-line flags and environment variables, and shared-cache hits now earn a default multiplier of 0.5 when shared cache is enabled through YAML. The overlap-query response no longer returns router_credit_blocks; use the raw cache-hit fields.
Migrate: Audit policy YAML for parameters that now override existing flags, and set shared_cache_multiplier: 0.0 explicitly if shared-cache hits should earn no credit.
Router requests always pass through the policy queue (#14176). Uncontended requests no longer bypass the queue, and a policy class with no registered workers returns a no-endpoints (service unavailable) error instead of a queue-rejected error.
Migrate: Update error handling that matched the queue-rejected error for an empty worker set.
Dynamo Planner caps throughput scaling at 8 replicas per decision per component (#14296).
Migrate: Raise max_throughput_scaling_replicas in the Planner configuration if you rely on larger single-step scaling.
Performance-model options renamed from AIConfigurator to AISimulate (--aic-* -> --ais-*, aic_perf_model -> ais_perf_model.roles) across the Planner, Mocker, and replay tools (#15063). Retired DYN_AIC_* environment variables now fail at startup.
Migrate: Rename --aic-* flags to their --ais-* equivalents, replace DYN_AIC_* environment variables with their AIS equivalents, and move Planner performance-model settings under ais_perf_model.roles. The old CLI spellings are accepted only temporarily.
KV routing rejects text-input workers at discovery (#16938). vLLM workers started with --use-vllm-tokenizer, and other text-input workers, are no longer admitted when the effective Router mode requires KV routing.
Migrate: Remove --use-vllm-tokenizer so the frontend tokenizes, or select a non-KV Router mode for those workers.
Runtime, Transport, and Metrics
Invalid DYN_REQUEST_PLANE values fail at startup (#12612). Empty or unrecognized values previously fell back to TCP silently.
Migrate: Unset DYN_REQUEST_PLANE or set it to tcp or nats.
Invalid DYN_EVENT_PLANE values fail at startup (#16712). A misspelled value previously logged a warning and fell back to ZMQ.
Migrate: Unset DYN_EVENT_PLANE or set it to nats or zmq.
Unbracketed IPv6 ZMQ endpoints are rejected (#15383). An address such as tcp://2001:db8::10:5555 now fails fast instead of retrying forever, IPv4 and hostname endpoints bind as IPv4 again, and a :: system-status bind advertises a non-loopback IPv4 address when no non-loopback IPv6 address exists.
Migrate: Bracket IPv6 hosts in event-plane endpoints (tcp://[2001:db8::10]:5555), and set an explicit advertise host if you relied on ::1.
Histogram bucket variables take effect under their documented names (DYN_HISTOGRAM_DYN_METRICS_* -> DYN_METRICS_*) (#14514). The documented DYN_METRICS_<HISTOGRAM>_MIN, _MAX, and _COUNT variables were previously ignored and now change bucket boundaries.
Migrate: Audit existing DYN_METRICS_* histogram settings.
NIXL telemetry settings are validated at startup (#14625). Unrecognized NIXL_TELEMETRY_ENABLE values and invalid ports are rejected, and the default NIXL Prometheus port changes from 19090 to 9090.
Migrate: Set NIXL_TELEMETRY_ENABLE to a boolean value such as y or n, and set NIXL_TELEMETRY_PROMETHEUS_PORT explicitly if your scrape configuration expects 19090.
Backends
--publish-kv-events no longer turns on TensorRT-LLM performance metrics (#12162, #14181). The flag now publishes KV events only; iteration statistics and forward-pass metrics have their own opt-in.
Migrate: Add --publish-metrics to TensorRT-LLM workers that relied on --publish-kv-events for performance or forward-pass metrics.
TensorRT-LLM sidecar speaks the OpenEngine gRPC API (#14349). Engines that serve only the older TensorRT-LLM gRPC service no longer work with the sidecar.
Migrate: Run a TensorRT-LLM build that serves the OpenEngine (openengine.v1) gRPC API.
vLLM-Omni diffusion options no longer carry hardcoded defaults (#14702). --boundary-ratio no longer defaults to 0.875, and the offload, VAE slicing, and VAE tiling switches stay unset unless provided, so each model's own defaults apply.
Migrate: Pass --boundary-ratio 0.875 or the matching --no-* flags explicitly if you depended on the previous values.
SGLang accepts top-logprob requests without an opt-in and validates top_logprobs strictly (#16927). logprobs: true without top_logprobs returns only the sampled token, and a positive top_logprobs without logprobs: true, or a negative, boolean, or non-integer value, returns HTTP 400.
Migrate: Send logprobs: true with any positive top_logprobs, set top_logprobs explicitly to receive alternatives, and remove DYN_SGL_ALLOW_TOP_LOGPROBS from deployments.
Deprecated and Removed
Removed the TensorRT-LLM AutoDeploy backend, which TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0rc29 deleted upstream with no replacement (#15418). PyTorch is now the only TensorRT-LLM backend, and backend: _autodeploy raises a clear error.
Migrate: Remove backend: _autodeploy from TensorRT-LLM extra engine arguments.
Removed the dynamo.mocker._worker compatibility module that v1.5.x retained for existing configurations (#14209).
Migrate: Launch live Mocker workers with python3 -m dynamo.mocker.
Deprecated DYN_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSERS_V2 in favor of DYN_PARSER_VERSION (#14950). The old variable still works with a warning, and a value that conflicts with DYN_PARSER_VERSION stops startup.
Migrate: Replace DYN_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSERS_V2=1 with DYN_PARSER_VERSION=2, or leave both unset to use each model family's default.
Deprecated component minAvailable in favor of native provider overrides, value.spec.minAvailable for standalone cliques and value.minAvailable for scaling groups (#15903).
Migrate: Move component minAvailable settings into the matching provider override.
Deprecated the Router scoring and selection flags in favor of --router-policy-config, including the six scoring flags, --load-aware, the prefill and decode selection and queue-threshold flags, and their environment variables such as DYN_SHARED_CACHE_MULTIPLIER (#15202). They are slated for removal in Dynamo v1.7.0.
Migrate: Move these settings into the policy YAML passed to --router-policy-config.
Deprecated --publish-events-and-metrics for TensorRT-LLM workers in favor of --publish-kv-events and --publish-metrics (#12162). The combined flag works for one more release.
Migrate: Replace it with one or both of the split flags.
Deprecated the legacy worker names in DynamoGraphDeploymentRequest overrides (VllmWorker, VllmPrefillWorker, VllmDecodeWorker, and the matching SGLang and TensorRT-LLM names) (#9848).
Migrate: Target worker, prefill, and decode in DGDR overrides.
Deprecated the gb200_sxm GPU SKU in DGDR v1beta1 in favor of gb200 (#15711).
Migrate: Set spec.hardware.gpuSku: gb200.
Deprecated the planner.powerAwareness.enabled Helm value (#14671). The Planner service account now always receives namespace-level pods/list permission, and power awareness is controlled by enable_power_awareness in the Planner configuration.
Migrate: Remove the value from your Helm values file.
Deprecated the doubled DYN_HISTOGRAM_DYN_METRICS_* variable names, which still work but log a warning (#14514).
Migrate: Use the documented DYN_METRICS_* names.
Features & Improvements
Frontend & Agents
Responses Tool Selection Hardening: Rejected unsupported tools and tool_choice variants on /v1/responses with an actionable HTTP 400 instead of dropping them silently (#14440), supported function-only tool_choice.allowed_tools (#14990), removed text-based tool call inference from non-streaming responses (#14846), and restored original function names and namespaces (#15401).
Parsers V2 Structural Tags: Added opt-in V2 parsers for GLM, DeepSeek V4/V4.1, Kimi K2/K3, Gemma 4, Muse, and Qwen3 (#14950), configured through --dyn-structural-tag (#16217). Structural tags are on by default for supported parsers (#15916), and vLLM tool-call tags can start inside reasoning (#16220).
KServe Tensor Protocol Fidelity: Added half-precision Float16 and BFloat16 KServe tensor variants (#14150), reported ModelMetadata datatypes by KServe v2 wire names (#14957), and translated Triton ModelConfig.dims to KServe shapes (#14996).
Semantic Error HTTP Mapping: Centralized semantic error mapping to HTTP status codes in Dynamo Frontend for protocol-correct OpenAI and Anthropic failures without internal diagnostics (#14396), and extended the JSON error envelope to the remaining OpenAI routes (#14002).
DeepSeek V4.1 Frontend Support: Added mainline frontend support for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reasoning and tool calling, enabled when workers pass both --dyn-tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 and --dyn-reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 (#15030), with native V4.1 image inputs and tool-result image ordering aligned to the rendered prompt by consuming the selected formatter's media order from dynamo-renderer (#15097).
SSE Streaming Lifecycle Hardening: Reworked SSE streams to end on a hard kill, not a graceful stop, so delayed events still finish (#14645), and made streaming handlers wait for the first backend event so an exception before output returns the non-streaming HTTP status (#14662).
Tokenizer Cache Lifecycle Hardening: Replaced the process-global tokenizer pool with a weak-reference registry that shuts down each tokenizer's thread pool once collected (#13368), and turned DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES into one combined budget per process, keeping the 64 MiB default (#15387).
Root-Level Thinking Token Budget: Added a root-level thinking_token_budget field to chat completion and Responses requests (#12624) and carried it into SGLang, which requires strict-thinking mode and a reasoning parser (#15120).
SGLang Cross-Encoder Reranking Endpoint: Added an OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/rerank endpoint for SGLang text-only cross-encoder models with a dedicated --rerank-worker mode and support for top_n (#14032), and fixed scheduler crashes in rerank workers serving XLM-RoBERTa cross-encoders (#16286).
Frontend HTTP Mutual TLS: Added a --tls-client-ca-cert-path flag and DYN_TLS_CLIENT_CA_CERT_PATH environment variable to the frontend HTTP server, requiring a CA-signed client certificate when set, with validation that rejects a client CA supplied without both a server certificate and key. Server-only TLS behavior remained unchanged (#14173).
Opt-In Jemalloc Preload: Added an opt-in jemalloc allocator preload for python -m dynamo.frontend, activated by DYN_FRONTEND_JEMALLOC=1, that continues with the default allocator when the library is missing (#14678), with libjemalloc2 installed in the SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM runtime images so the switch takes effect (#13101) and documentation on bounding frontend host memory growth (#13099).
Typed Chunk Metrics Path: Carried chunk metrics in the typed llm_metrics field instead of annotation comments, reducing mean inter-token latency by 6.21% with a 5.57% gain in output token throughput in a local A/B run (#15115).
Opaque Agent Header Preservation: Replaced the agent-compaction field with an agent_headers map of the x-claude-code-* and x-codex-* header families, so new coding-agent hints no longer require an envelope schema change (#15367).
Raw Completion Stop Preservation: Added an optional no_stop_trim field to /v1/completions that retains matched stop strings and stop/EOS token text so callers can see terminal markers, defaulting to false (#15519).
Scheduling
Session Prefix Indexing and Lineage: Added an opt-in session prefix index (--enable-session-prefix-index) that tracks the KV blocks each session has built per worker and DP rank from vLLM KV events (#13807, #13806), hardened worker-removal handling and capped session identifiers at 256 bytes (#15362), and grouped subagent requests under their parent session so they land on one worker (#14521).
Standalone EPP Routing Enablement: Passed expected_output_tokens and policy_class from the standalone endpoint picker (EPP) into its selection service (#13595), routed runtime EPP requests by the x-dynamo-meta-policy-class header (#14480), added cache namespace and salt resolution (#13714) and sglang-renderer tokenizer support (#14501), and made native EPP atomically reserve KV-routed prefill capacity (#13042).
Pluggable Router Flow Control: Added a pluggable request-classifier hook to the KV Router that can defer a request, override scheduling inputs, or suggest a worker without overriding explicit pins (#14123), with a deadline-ordered policy queue for every request (#14176), async classifier lifecycle events (#14177), and one plugin registration catalog (#14149). Skipped capacity checks for policy classes with queueing disabled (#15423).
ThunderAgent Builtin Router Plugin: Shipped ThunderAgent as a builtin router plugin enabled through --router-policy-config (#15164), made its cost model DP-rank aware so SGLang data-parallel attention workers no longer fail program-lifecycle requests (#14000), and made it honor the Router's pinned worker and check that worker's live capacity (#15290).
KV Router Slot Tracker Recovery: Cut slot tracker overhead by sharding its locks (#15531), tied standalone replica sync to each request's reservation so peer routers no longer see a re-added request's prefill as complete (#15578), reworked the recovery snapshot cache (#15551), and restored buffer-first gap recovery that keeps the existing index on a KV event gap (#14627).
Planner GPU Budget Enforcement: Added runtime reconfiguration of endpoint floors and min_gpu_budget/max_gpu_budget bounds through PATCH /v1/min-endpoints (#14218), treated min_gpu_budget as a scale-down guard (#14231), and preserved the decode replica count when a raised GPU floor would reduce it (#15466). Applied min_endpoint in single-pool load scaling (#15530) and distinguished startup from drain and rollout so falling demand cannot cancel pending capacity or drain serving workers (#14671).
Planner Gym Autoscaler Evaluation: Added an experimental Planner Gym under gyms/planner-gym that compares Planner, KEDA/HPA-style, reactive, and static autoscaling policies (#15576), resolved its defaults through the production Planner configuration (#15678), and removed stale offline replay restrictions so Planner policies run on agentic Mooncake and Dynamo or Weka traces (#15435).
Phase-Aware Prefill Accounting: Gated prefill-start recording off for decode-only requests (#14019), moved SGLang prefill completion to after the background prefill stream ends (#14968), and fixed output-block undercounting across block boundaries and batched those updates (#14613, #15448).
Direct ZMQ Subscriber Multiplexing: Added opt-in fan-in via DYN_ROUTER_ZMQ_ENDPOINTS_PER_SUB so direct-ZMQ subscribers share one SUB socket across many publisher endpoints (#14219), and coalesced pending KV load metrics (#15587).
Standalone Indexer Lifecycle Delegates: Added ownership callbacks to the standalone KV indexer that notify consumers when a block hash gains its first owner or its last owner releases it (#14945), made cleanup safe for absent blocks and backpressure (#14652), and bounded the KV state-agent discovery wait at vLLM startup (#14003).
Unified Selection Core: Unified Dynamo Frontend, standalone selection service, and EPP worker selection on one shared core (#14570) and reduced scheduler and dispatch overhead for large worker pools (#14666).
TokenSpeed Disaggregation with KV Routing: Added prefill/decode disaggregation for the TokenSpeed backend over Mooncake and published native KV-cache events, so the Router can send prompts to the prefill worker already holding their prefix. Included bootstrap validation and transfer-error handling (#9237).
Native KV Cache Events: Added a native TensorRT-LLM KV cache event mode that subscribes directly to each attention-DP rank's ZMQ stream, bypassing the legacy polling and republishing path (#12167).
Throughput Scaling Replica Cap: Added the max_throughput_scaling_replicas Planner configuration option, defaulting to 8, and applied it per component to both throughput scale-up and scale-down targets, with capped targets fitted against GPU and power ceilings while preserving explicit endpoint and out-of-band budget recovery (#14296).
Relay WAN gRPC Transport: Added a dynamo.kvrelay.v1 Protobuf contract and WAN adapter so consumers outside a data center can subscribe to cache locality, readiness, and KV occupancy streams through an opt-in listener (#14379).
Router KV Hints Envelope: Passed Router-produced KV hints to vLLM through vLLM's dedicated KV-hints request argument, keeping hint data separate from the KV connector's kv_transfer_params on token, text, and prefill paths. In prefill/decode deployments the hint is applied once on the prefill worker, and decode handoff requests no longer replay it (#14890).
Centralized Router Policy Configuration: Moved Router scoring knobs into --router-policy-config with a router section for shared cache settings, deprecated the six scoring flags and --load-aware while their behavior remains available for migration, and removed router_credit_blocks from the overlap-query response (#15202). Added a soft-pin-repin policy example for soft session-affinity rebinding (#14152).
Worker KV Reuse Telemetry: Added router metrics for KV cache reuse per routing attempt across SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, labeled by phase and model, so operators can compare routed prompt tokens against engine cache hits (#15443).
KV Block Manager
File-Based Relay Source Mode: Added a --sources-file option to KV DC Relay that selects Dynamo namespaces from a versioned JSON file with live reload, and an /engine/state route reporting readiness (#14807).
Multimodal & Diffusion
Nemotron Omni Multimodal Routing: Added exact multimodal KV routing for Nemotron 3 Nano Omni images by modeling vLLM dynamic-resolution geometry and model-specific delimiters (#14564), and for video by sampling and decoding frames and grouping them into temporal tubelets (#14653).
Cascaded Nemotron Speech Example: Added a self-contained deployment example exposing Nemotron ASR, LLM, and TTS endpoints through /v1/realtime transcription and streaming /v1/audio/speech, with a three-GPU DynamoGraphDeployment and a smoke client (#12567), and added a client-driven ASR-to-LLM handoff for speculative prefix-cache warming (#14327).
Omni Video Parameter Plumbing: Preserved joint video-and-audio output from vLLM-Omni with per-output frame rate and audio sample rate metadata (#13707), cloned sampling parameters so request-specific video controls do not leak across requests (#13708), and forwarded response_format so b64_json is no longer dropped (#14844). Also fixed the HTTP 500 on video requests carrying nvext.negative_prompt and carried the value to the first-stage engine prompt (#15402, #15541).
MiniMax-H3 FastH3 Video Enablement: Added a four-B200 aggregated vLLM-Omni launcher for MiniMax-H3 text-to-video-and-audio generation with the four-step Dense FastH3 startup adapter (#13589), then enabled MiniMax-H3 video sparse attention (VSA) on vLLM-Omni with the --fastvideo-vsa-topk option and B200 and GB300 hardware guards (#14702).
Shared Encoded-Image Cache Hardening: Added an opt-in shared cache of encoded image bytes in Redis Cluster or Dragonfly, failing open on any cache error (#14676). Fixed case-differing S3 and GCS paths collapsing onto one image cache entry (#15101), made the embedding cache evict only while it needs space (#15497), and stopped the NIXL embedding ring buffer from overlapping a live embedding (#15498).
vLLM External Encoder Handoff: Added a public ExternalEncoderHandoff API so external encoders built on VisionEncoderBackend reuse Dynamo's image extraction and prompt reconstruction (#13293), forwarded preprocessed multimodal features to vLLM's gRPC API (#14244), and moved multimodal tensor transfer from pickle to typed msgpack (#14433).
Multimodal UUID and Media Deduplication: Extended client-provided multimodal UUID forwarding from images to all modalities for vLLM-based deployments (#14300), and stopped inline data: media from being sent twice on the TCP request plane (#14801).
Nemotron Audex Speech Synthesis: Added Nemotron Audex text-to-speech support to the vLLM-Omni backend on the existing /v1/audio/speech endpoint, covering nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Audex-2B and nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B. Added cfg_scale to the frontend and worker request models for classifier-free guidance, and fixed cumulative waveform assembly so Audex requests no longer return silent or over-length audio (#12788).
SGLang Qwen Video KV Routing: Added video-aware KV cache routing for Qwen models on SGLang, mirroring SGLang's frame sampling in the frontend so repeated video requests hit cached prefix blocks (#15014). Extended the Multimodal KV Routing guide with video identity handling, documenting vLLM support for Qwen3-VL, Qwen3.5, and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni (#14958).
Kubernetes Deployment
LPX Integration and Partition Selection: Added the LPX component type for LPU-backed inference across API, controller, runtime, scheduler, Grove, and Helm (#15062), let hybrid XT and HX (LP30) builds run some or all partitions on the Cyborg GPU via lpx.experimental.localPartitions (#15563, #15706), packed LPU-only PropSync partitions into whole-node allocations (#15583), and fixed HX hybrid deployments (#15804).
Rolling LPX Build Updates: Routed compatible lpx.buildId changes through Grove rolling updates so remaining replicas keep serving (#15607), and excluded RollingUpdate from the layout comparison so an unchanged PodCliqueSet is no longer recreated (#15672).
Role-Specific Multinode PodTemplate API: Activated the roles[].podTemplate API for multinode worker, prefill, and decode components so leader and worker Pods can come from different complete PodTemplates (#14468, #14544), added an explicit roles[].replicas surface for role cardinality (#14477), and restricted multinode to inference-engine component types (#14533).
Snapshot CUDA Shared Memory Capture: Enabled CUDA shared-memory Snapshot capture so workers no longer disable NCCL cuMem, NVLS or TensorRT-LLM zero-copy, and existing checkpoints are recaptured because the compatibility hash includes the annotation (#15791), with SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM (v0.31.0 and later) releasing only the KV cache before capture instead of moving weights to host memory, which shrinks checkpoints and speeds restores (#16358).
Snapshot-Backed Engine Failover: Added snapshot-backed engine failover for SGLang and vLLM, including single-node multi-GPU workers, that replenishes a failed engine without replacing the worker Pod, with unsupported snapshot failover backends rejected at admission (#15924), and propagated the compatibility hash to WaitForCheckpoint references (#16687).
Intel XPU GMS Support: Added Intel XPU support to the GPU Memory Service (GMS), using Level-Zero interop for inter-process memory sharing, a C++ extension for tensor reconstruction, and SGLang and vLLM integration paths. XPU support runs on native torch.xpu with no IPEX dependency and requires PyTorch 2.13 or newer (#12484).
GA Helm OCI Publishing: Added a push of GA Helm charts to the NGC OCI registry alongside the existing ChartMuseum push, so consumers on OCI-only registries such as ACR, ECR, and Harbor can mirror released charts (#13657).
KVCR Resiliency Deployment Example: Added a two-node vLLM KV Cache Reuse (KVCR) example over RDMA. The memory-service sidecar keeps the KVCR Guard available across engine restarts (#14695).
EPP Multi-Replica Support: Removed the admission rule that restricted the Dynamo-mode endpoint picker (EPP) to exactly one replica, so native Rust EPP deployments can scale out and tolerate pod loss like the Frontend-hosted Router, while legacy Go EPP deployments still require a single replica. DYN_ROUTER_REPLICA_SYNC remained off by default, matching the Frontend behavior (#14758).
Portable Multinode Topology Variables: Added DYNAMO_RANK and DYNAMO_LEADER_ADDRESS to new multinode components so SGLang and vLLM commands no longer depend on Grove or LeaderWorkerSet syntax. Injection is gated on the operator origin version, so existing deployments keep their current environment and command lines, and Grove was upgraded to v0.1.0-alpha.14 (#15374, #15704).
Dynamo Sidecar
Dynamo Sidecar remains experimental in Dynamo v1.6.0.
vLLM Sidecar LoRA Lifecycle: Added dynamic LoRA load, unload, and per-request adapter selection to the vLLM sidecar, with local, Hugging Face, and S3 adapters and no silent base-model fallback for unavailable adapters (#13068). Added aggregated and NIXL prefill/decode launchers for local LoRA serving (#14574).
TensorRT-LLM OpenEngine gRPC Sidecar: Moved the TensorRT-LLM sidecar onto TensorRT-LLM's OpenEngine (openengine.v1) gRPC API and added disaggregated serving (#14349). Raised the shared sidecar gRPC startup deadline from 300 to 1,800 seconds for large model loads (#14825).
vLLM Sidecar EPD Encode Role: Added opt-in Encoder-Prefill-Decode support to the native vLLM gRPC sidecar with E+PD and E+P+D launchers (#13966). Extended the Encode worker to accept video and combined image plus video requests (#15287), and shipped the FFmpeg binaries video decode needs for VP8 and VP9 (#16556).
SGLang Sidecar KV Routing: Added a disaggregated KV-aware routing launcher for SGLang sidecars (#13862) and node-local KV event relay for multinode headless sidecars (#14908). Published HiCache capacity so capacity-aware routers no longer treat HiCache workers as device-only (#14313) and an EAGLE flag so KV routers use the engine's bigram hashing (#14374), and moved the prefill bootstrap handoff into a nonterminal response (#14260).
Multimodal-Aware vLLM KV Routing: Resolved the image placeholder token for the vLLM KV event publisher, so repeated image requests match cached image blocks instead of only the text prefix. The token resolves once at startup with a 30 second fetch limit, and image requests fall back to text-prefix routing if resolution fails (#13360).
Standalone Decode Sidecar Contract: Added a standalone decode sidecar for the inference gateway that validates x-prefiller-host-port metadata so client-supplied prefill metadata cannot reach endpoint selection (#13669).
Engine-Primary Dynamo Native Sidecars: Added operator support for separate inference engine and Dynamo runtime containers, selected per component via an init container named runtime, while combined mode remains the default (#14927).
Shared Sidecar Transport Flags: Added --discovery-backend, --request-plane, --response-plane, and --event-plane to the SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM sidecars, so workers select file, tcp, quic, or zmq directly (#15653).
SGLang
Sharded SGLang Worker Gateway: Added --gateway-workers to shard the dynamo.sglang gateway across processes so tokenizer intake and output relay no longer share one GIL (#15078), and fixed a startup AttributeError (#16337).
SGLang Cache Salt Routing: Added cache salt support for SGLang text workers so differently salted requests use separate KV cache entries. Non-empty salts are rejected when the installed engine or request type cannot honor them. Upgrade all workers and routers before enabling salted traffic (#14803).
vLLM
Generate Endpoint RL Parity: Added reinforcement learning (RL) serving parity for the dynamo.vllm worker in aggregated deployments, adapting native Generate token-in/token-out requests and publishing RL administration routes (#15179). Carried typed /inference/v1/generate controls such as sampling, stop-token IDs, and logprobs into Dynamo's internal request, preserving requests from v1.4 frontends (#14398), with a fix that sent top_k and min_p as unset when clients did not disable them (#15286).
LMCacheMPConnector PD Support: Registered a connector adapter so vLLM prefill/decode disaggregation works with LMCacheMPConnector, which previously failed at request time with an unsupported connector error. Wrapper resolution now prefers a connector that produces KV transfer parameters, so MultiConnector setups combining LMCacheMP with NixlConnector still resolve to NIXL (#13258).
Incremental Realtime Text Input: Added text-only /v1/realtime sessions to aggregated vLLM workers, with experimental input events so clients can forward ASR text during transcription and commit the final transcript (#14326).
Triton
FP16/BF16 Tensor Input Support: Dropped the dynamo.triton guard that rejected FP16 and BF16 inputs (#14835), reinterpreted their values from raw uint16 bit patterns (#16683), and passed BF16 as a raw-byte tensor (#16558).
KServe Classification Output Support: Added support for the KServe classification requested-output parameter on the Triton worker and forwarded requested outputs from the frontend (#14618), so the worker returns only the named tensors (#14783).
Defunct Triton Example Removal: Removed the out-of-date Triton Inference Server backend example, including its Dockerfile, launch scripts, model repository, and worker implementation. The Dynamo Triton Runtime under components/src/dynamo/triton replaces it (#15170).
Triton Classification Endpoint Support: Added OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/classify serving to the Triton backend, opt-in through --task classify with input and output tensor names auto-detected from config.pbtxt and overridable via --classify-input-name and --classify-output-name. The default --task tensor KServe path is unchanged, and text-only input is supported while token-ID variants and encoding_format requests return HTTP 400 (#15396).
Model Loading & LoRA
Native LoRA Capacity Reporting: Exposed native vLLM LoRA capacity through shared model registration, so a worker reporting max_loras=4 carries max_gpu_lora_count=4 into discovery (#14754), and corrected LoRA allocation simulation with capacity-bounded adapter residency and churn, hit, and occupancy metrics (#13758).
Shared NGC Model Fetching: Added shared NGC model fetching through ModelExpress for SGLang and vLLM, reusing cached models (#15441). Local models served under custom names no longer trigger hf:// metadata fetches on offline hosts (#15964).
Performance Modeling & Replay
Typed Agentic Replay Adapters: Added a streaming Weka importer in dynamo-data-gen, lowered Weka and Claude/Codex/Dynamo request traces into versioned Agentic Mooncake v2 rows, and added Dynamo replay entrypoints for typed agentic lanes (#13586).
Codex and Claude Trace Export: Added an offline Codex trace exporter for agentic replay alongside the Claude exporter and fixed Claude export so a full local corpus replays. Claude export on a 216 MB project dropped from 49 s to 2.6 s and peak RSS from 2.3 GB to 1.3 GB (#15601).
Mocker Host-Memory KV Offload: Wired AISimulate's vLLM host-memory KV offload into the Mocker with tier-aware KV routing, so the Router tracks host-resident blocks and --num-host-blocks alone enables host offload (#15647).
AISimulate Canonical Configuration: Moved performance-model consumers across the Planner, Profiler, Router, Frontend, Mocker, and replay to AISimulate's canonical configuration interface, carrying complete configurations through Planner roles and the related CLI consumers (#15063).
Fault Tolerance & Observability
Frontend NUMA Affinity Warning: Added a startup check that warns when the frontend's allowed CPUs span multiple NUMA nodes, a likely source of degraded performance (#11184).
Tokio Queue Overload Warnings: Added detection of sustained Tokio runnable-queue pressure in the runtime metrics loop, with worker-scaled thresholds, hot-worker detection, hysteresis, and sample-gap checks. Warnings log once per overload episode and repeat at most every five minutes while it continues, and the count is exported as dynamo_tokio_queue_overload_warnings_total for operators (#13027).
OTLP Metrics Export: Added a periodic OTLP exporter that ships Dynamo and engine metrics to a collector over gRPC, configured through standard OTEL_* variables and off unless OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp is set (#14071).
Per-Request Lifecycle Instrumentation: Added opt-in runtime tracing that models each inference request as a finite-state machine, recording state timing and terminal outcome for aggregated and disaggregated serving (#14101).
Buffered JSONL FPM Recording: Added --output, --log-metrics, and --flush-interval options to the forward pass metrics (FPM) receiver, writing one JSON record per message to a new file and flushing on an interval (#14511).
NVTX Ranges in Wheels: Compiled the runtime's NVTX ranges into published wheels, so the preprocess.*, route.*, transport.*, and detokenize ranges appear in Nsight reports when DYN_ENABLE_RUST_NVTX is set, and removed the dependency on libnvToolsExt.so, which CUDA 12.9 dropped (#15242).
Runtime & Transport
Request-Plane Transport Configuration Hardening: Added DYN_EVENT_PLANE_HOST to override the address advertised by direct ZMQ event publishers (#11870). Restricted DYN_REQUEST_PLANE to default to TCP only when absent, so invalid values surface as startup errors (#12612), and defaulted the event-plane context to four libzmq I/O threads with a DYN_ZMQ_IO_THREADS override (#14517).
Configurable Etcd Startup Retry: Made the etcd startup retry timeout configurable, keeping 120 seconds as the default and bounding each individual connection attempt by the remaining retry window (#13742).
Batched QUIC Response Transport: Added an opt-in batched QUIC response plane selected with --response-plane quic or DYN_RESPONSE_PLANE=quic on each frontend and worker. TCP remains the default (#11996).
Packed Int32 Token IDs: Added an opt-in DYN_TOKEN_IDS_AS_BYTES flag that serializes token_ids as a packed int32 blob on request-plane codecs. It must stay off until all msgpack workers run a release containing the new reader (#15326).
Unary Endpoint Helper APIs: Added unary endpoint utilities that serve a handler result and collect unary responses and LLM token streams while preserving request context (#12920), then promoted them to dynamo.runtime and dynamo.llm (#15195).
Shared Prompt Token Storage: Made copies of a preprocessed request share one prompt-token buffer, reducing clone cost for disaggregated prefill and migration, though direct Rust consumers of token_ids may need adaptation (#14701).
Unary Chat Model Publisher: Added UnaryChatModel to dynamo.llm, which registers and serves a Chat model endpoint, plus LLMUnaryClient.connect, which waits for a routable instance (#15552).

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B SGLang Recipes: Added SGLang multi-token prediction deployment recipes for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on B200, GB200, and H200 GPUs, along with model-download configurations, smoke tests, benchmark results, and catalog and documentation entries (#13958).
