Bug Fixes
Frontend & Agents
Anthropic Tool-Call Conversion Fidelity: Fixed Anthropic Messages conversion so buffered tool calls are emitted after an early finish reason (#15129) and the single-call limit from tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use is applied (#14605). Preserved tool.strict (#16206), mapped output_config.format to response_format (#16207), and suppressed tool calls whose tool_use.input is not a JSON object (#16214).
Anthropic Messages Protocol Corrections: Reworked Anthropic streaming so text after a tool call opens a new block (#15467), reported stop_reason: "stop_sequence" with the matched string (#16417), and stripped the Claude Code billing preamble by default (#15826).
SGLang Structured-Output Reasoning Gating: Extended the reasoning gate to structured response formats so JSON no longer returns entirely in reasoning_content (#14465), gave forced tool_choice precedence over response_format (#14179), gated tool_choice="auto" grammars on reasoning to avoid responses that contain neither an answer nor a tool call (#15227), and bypassed the tool parser for ungated answer JSON (#15515).
SGLang Chat Processor Parser Fixes: Passed the checkpoint tokenizer to SGLang parsers so reasoning and tool calls are detected when checkpoint delimiters differ from defaults (#15509), retained parser-declared tool closing delimiters during stop handling (#15510), honored explicit skip_special_tokens=false (#14602), and returned chat-template errors as invalid-argument errors (#15511).
Truncated Tool-Call Finish Reasons: Preserved finish_reason: "length" at max_tokens rather than a completed tool call (#13791), suppressed the incomplete final tool call in Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages (#13792), and reported streams ending inside GLM-4.7 tool-call blocks as length-limited (#15184).
Chat and Completion Logprobs Reporting: Returned prompt logprobs at the root of non-streaming chat completion responses (#13957), emitted completion top_logprobs as token-to-logprob maps (#15521), and mapped chat logprobs onto vLLM sampling parameters instead of rejecting them (#15670).
Request Parameter Validation Hardening: Returned HTTP 400 instead of generic 500 for conflicting guided-decoding options (#13790), and aligned stop-sequence limits so excess stop or stop_token_ids entries fail with 400 (#14462). Also rejected an explicit empty tools array (#16231) and logit_bias keys that are not non-negative 32-bit integers (#16322), and validated strict: true function parameter schemas before inference (#16219).
Configurable HTTP Listen Backlog: Replaced the frontend HTTP listener's 128-entry queue with a configurable backlog defaulting to 4096, preventing Connection reset by peer during connection bursts (#15080), and restored the TCP call-home listener's 4096 backlog (#15270).
Multimodal Media Forwarding Fixes: Fixed SGLang and vLLM chat processors to read media from tool messages too, avoiding image count mismatches (#15237), converted Responses function_call_output image parts instead of rejecting them (#15306), and closed validation for audio, image, and video requests (#15420).
Raw Reasoning Output Preservation: Preserved backend reasoning_content in the /v1/responses API, with non-streaming responses returning reasoning_text content instead of summary_text and streaming responses emitting response.reasoning_text.delta plus the corresponding added and done events. Reasoning, text, and tool-call ordering is retained across interleaved reasoning spans, and summary remains as a compatibility fallback (#11604).
Scoped Tool-Call Array Bound: Fixed guided decoding so the maxItems=1 constraint applied when parallel_tool_calls=False is limited to tool_choice="required" schemas instead of also hitting named function choices. Array-typed function parameters no longer get truncated to a single element, and the caller's request dictionary is no longer mutated in place (#13242).
Speculative Prefill Warmup Lifetime: Bounded prefill warmup tasks to their preprocessor's lifetime with a 60-second warmup deadline after the client response finishes and a process-wide limit of four concurrent speculative preprocessing operations, so stalled backends or never-ending response streams no longer retain request resources indefinitely (#13438).
Incremental Tool-Call Streaming: Fixed vLLM preprocessing to stream tool-call deltas as the parser emits them instead of buffering them until the end of a completion, so consumers receive incremental SSE frames (#13975).
Client Token ID Bounds: Added client token id validation for nvext.token_data, completion prompt, and embedding input, so an id at or above the vocabulary bound returns HTTP 400 instead of reaching the engine (#14475).
SGLang Worker Routing Hints: Fixed the SGLang chat processor to forward backend_instance_id, decode_worker_id, prefill_worker_id, dp_rank, and prefill_dp_rank from nvext into the request routing fields. Requests pinned to a specific worker or data-parallel rank previously reached the Router unpinned and could be sent to a different worker (#14696).
Kimi Dynamic Tool Declarations: Added support for Kimi K3 message extensions so tools declared only in system.tools are treated like top-level OpenAI tools across request validation, tool-choice handling, guided decoding, parser definitions, stop-token behavior, and response gating, with dynamic declarations preserved at their original message positions to maintain prompt ordering and prefix-cache behavior (#14755).
Null Optional Completion Parameters: Fixed the frontend to treat explicit null values as omitted for recognized passthrough fields such as cache_salt and stop_token_ids, and for stream_options.include_usage and stream_options.continuous_usage_stats on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions. OpenAI-compatible clients that serialize unset optional parameters as null no longer receive HTTP 400 validation errors (#14847).
Responses API Metadata Echo: Fixed the Responses API to echo request metadata in both non-streaming and streaming responses, which was previously replaced with an empty map when Dynamo built the response. Requests without metadata continue to return an empty object (#15102).
Renderer Message Rewrite Preservation: Made the frontend render transformed messages, preserving tool argument normalization and the continue_final_message marker instead of falling back to the original history. Ordinary requests keep the typed fast path (#15163).
Reordered Message Continuation Guard: Rejected continue_final_message requests with an InvalidArgument error before tokenization when the prompt formatter moves the final input message ahead of other messages, preventing silently truncated prompts and discarded tool results. Continuation still works for ordered tool results and assistant prefixes (#15247).
Anthropic Hosted Tool Rejection: Changed /v1/messages to return HTTP 400 with invalid_request_error instead of HTTP 501 for unsupported hosted tools, so clients stop retrying a deterministic rejection, and aligned the behavior with the /v1/responses hosted-tool policy while preserving NotImplemented request metrics (#15468).
Refusal Text Preservation: Fixed aggregated non-streaming chat responses dropping refusal text by accumulating refusal fragments per choice and retaining them in the final message, so clients receive the full refusal content. Responses without refusal text remain unchanged (#15516).
Streaming Cached-Token Usage: Fixed SGLang and vLLM streaming so sparsely reported cached-token usage reaches the client and explicit zero cache counts are preserved. Streaming usage now follows stream_options.include_usage and continuous_usage_stats (#16944).
Scheduling
Planner Load Predictor Correctness: Clamped Kalman forecasts at zero so they no longer go negative (#14497), scored failed simulation presets honestly (#14515), weighted frontend histogram averages by observation count (#14705), and reported unreadable request counts as unknown rather than zero (#14766).
Per-Rank DP Capacity Handling: Normalized aggregate vLLM KV capacity to per-rank values and rejected zero data-parallel rank counts (#14258), and hardened the Router for empty prompts, DP ranges, and large KV events (#15303).
KV Router Lookup Repair: Fixed lazy cross-worker reverse-lookup repair in the KV Router compressed radix tree so repair updates only existing entries, preventing scrubbed keys from being recreated and reviving phantom tracked blocks. Store paths retained their insertion behavior for newly stored blocks (#11891).
Non-Blocking Prometheus Metrics Collection: Moved Planner traffic, KV-only, and accept-length collection to a background thread so slow Prometheus queries no longer block the event loop, keeping control API requests responsive. Shared metrics are published on the event loop only after a successful collection, and collect_accept_length() is now async across provider and environment protocols (#14377).
Atomic Planner Decision Publishing: Fixed the virtual Planner to publish worker counts and decision ID in a single etcd transaction, so clients no longer observe partial scaling decisions (#14809).
Pending Virtual Connector Decisions: Fixed VirtualConnectorClient.wait() in the Planner to return immediately when an unacknowledged scaling decision already exists in etcd, instead of only reporting decisions published after the watch started. Consumers no longer miss a decision published before they began waiting (#14841).
Rust Worker Topology Policy: Added topology policy loading in dynamo-backend-common so Rust workers read topology settings before model registration and publish the same topology fields as Python workers. The loader waits up to 30 seconds for delayed projection (#14909).
KV Router Lease Leak Fix: Fixed a reference cycle between the KV Router scheduler and lease manager, so dropped or failed routers no longer leak scheduler and lease state (#15258).
Non-Finite Router Weight Rejection: Made Router configuration reject infinite and NaN values for overlap_score_credit_decay, prefill_load_scale, router_temperature, and decode_active_request_weight at validation time instead of failing on every request after startup. Finite values, including the largest representable value, behave as before (#15529).
SGLang Mooncake Key Prefix: Fixed shared-cache lookups with --shared-cache-type hicache so the Router matches SGLang's Mooncake keys, which are prefixed with the backend tag and model name (#16427).
Prefill Activation Fail-Closed: Fixed disaggregated serving during rollouts so requests arriving while the prefill binding is activating receive a retryable 503 instead of being forwarded straight to decode without bootstrap_info, so clients receive the 503 instead of a 500 (#16942).
Stale Router Discovery Record Removal: Removed the obsolete router-discovery advertisement, whose stale transport could prevent a KV-routing frontend from initializing after a container restart. Worker discovery and request and response formats are unchanged, and a KV frontend without another RPC endpoint no longer binds DYN_TCP_RPC_PORT. The last release that consumed the record was Dynamo v1.3.1 (#16828).
Multimodal & Diffusion
Qwen3-ASR Realtime Example Support: Reworked the vLLM realtime launch example to use vLLM's native Qwen3ASRRealtimeGeneration instead of forcing the Voxtral architecture (#15481), and set Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B as the default realtime ASR model (#16438).
Multimodal Request Error Propagation: Surfaced image generation failures instead of returning HTTP 200 with empty data (#13000), mapped timeouts and connection failures on user-supplied image URLs to 408 and 400 (#14240), preserved malformed data: URIs as 400 rather than collapsing to 500 (#14603), and returned 400 for multimodal requests to text-only vLLM prefill workers (#15305). The Rust frontend with --frontend-decoding now returns HTTP 400 naming the modality instead of HTTP 500 for image_url and video_url parts that fail (#16829).
Shared HTTP Client Media Fetching: Routed remote media downloads through the shared HTTP client with URL validation and size limits for TensorRT-LLM .safetensors embedding URLs (#14373) and vLLM-Omni ref_audio voice-cloning downloads (#14372), and enforced the DYN_MM_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB cap, 64 MiB by default, on remote image, audio, and video downloads (#15005).
EPD Encode Worker Hardening: Fixed the vLLM E/P/D encode worker answering 503 forever instead of reporting healthy (#15434), and enabled per-worker port isolation and readiness checks in the multimodal launch scripts (#14751).
Qwen DeepStack Embedding Size: Fixed Qwen multimodal placeholder generation in vLLM to use the model's actual vision embedding dimension instead of a fixed value, resolving tensor splitting errors when running DeepStack-based models such as the Qwen3-VL series (#11244).
Multimodal Processor Kwargs Forwarding: Fixed the TensorRT-LLM backend dropping per-request mm_processor_kwargs, which were hardcoded to an empty dictionary before reaching generate_async while the request still returned HTTP 200. The value is now read from the top-level field with an extra_args fallback, matching the precedence used by the vLLM backend (#13856).
Data URI Video Decoding: Fixed TensorRT-LLM multimodal handling so inline data: URI videos are base64-decoded and passed through the same codec probe and NVDEC path as fetched HTTP(S) bytes, instead of failing with an undetected codec error. Malformed or non-base64 URIs and payloads exceeding max_file_size_bytes now return HTTP 400 (#15219).
Idle Media-Loader CPU Fix: Fixed media-loader NIXL agent busy-polling by setting a 1 ms progress-thread delay, dropping idle frontend CPU use from 200% to 1.9% per multimodal worker set, and drained per-read notifications that leaked about 110 bytes per image (#15289).
Multimodal Decode KV Identity: Fixed non-Qwen vLLM decode workers clearing multi_modal_data, which let same-size images collide in the decode prefix cache so a request could reuse another request's image KV (#15371).
TTS Task Type Validation: Fixed vLLM Omni to reject a task_type the Qwen3-TTS checkpoint cannot serve with a 400 instead of terminating the stage, so later valid requests no longer fail (#15591).
Unsupported Diffusion Layer Count: Fixed vLLM-Omni image and video worker startup by omitting the obsolete layerwise_num_gpu_layers field by default, which the diffusion configuration validator rejected before engine initialization completed. Explicit legacy CLI or environment values are now rejected during Dynamo configuration validation with guidance to use --enable-layerwise-offload without a layer-count override (#16238).
Kubernetes Deployment
Unified vLLM Flag Parsing: Consolidated the Operator's vLLM argument readers so every flag spelling resolved identically (#15028), and resolved repeated flags to the last occurrence, correcting world size derivation (#15224).
DGDR GPU SKU Discovery: Added canonical SKU identifiers to DGDR GPU discovery, starting with b300_sxm for NVIDIA B300 variants, so an omitted spec.hardware.gpuSku no longer persisted an enum-invalid product name (#15216). Canonicalized GB200 to gb200, retaining gb200_sxm as a deprecated value with an admission warning (#15711), and added Vera Rubin NVL72 support as vr_nvl72 (#15996).
SGLang Snapshot Memory Saver Fixes: Enabled the SGLang memory saver during argument parsing when Dynamo snapshot mode is active and suppressed raw forward-pass metrics during snapshot startup including restored pods carrying DYN_FORWARDPASS_METRIC_PORT (#14555).
DGD Adoption and Metadata Validation: Hardened DGDR adoption to reject an unrelated DGD with the same name and refuse to replace its confirmed deployment (#13885), and validated durable metadata on terminating DGD updates, which previously accepted every mutation (#13486).
Oversized Metadata Header Status: Changed the standalone endpoint picker provider (EPP) to return HTTP 431 Request Header Fields Too Large for oversized scheduling metadata headers instead of 400, and kept the too-many-entries and too-large cases distinguishable, matching the integrated frontend behavior (#14612).
Worker Hash Input Normalization: Fixed the Operator worker hash computation to canonicalize semantically equivalent configurations, including empty Grove wrappers, forceScalingGroup: false, disabled checkpoint settings, and explicit backend-default compilation-cache mount paths. Representation-only differences no longer change the nvidia.com/dynamo-worker-hash label, though deployments using the explicit forms may see a one-time hash change after upgrading (#14721).
Init Container Pull Secrets: Fixed image pull secret discovery in the Operator to scan init container images in addition to regular containers, so components with a public main image and a private initialization image no longer fail to start without explicitly configured credentials. Explicit pull secrets, deduplication, and discovery-disable behavior were preserved (#14922).
Bounded Dynamo Namespace Labels: Fixed derived Dynamo namespaces that exceeded the 63-byte Kubernetes label limit by shortening them to a readable prefix plus a hash, preventing Grove from rejecting a generated PodCliqueSet (#16414).
Shadow-Mode KV Sizing Fix: Reserved the co-located peer engine's non-KV memory in the shadow-mode vLLM scratch-KV budget, charging each engine 2 GiB for allocations outside PyTorch's allocator plus 1.25 GiB for the CUDA context, so the failover winner's KV cache fits instead of timing out while the peer is still resident (#16710).
Authored Frontend Command Handling: Fixed the Operator so an authored command on a frontend container or frontend sidecar owns the entire argv, dropping the default frontend Args that previously duplicated -m dynamo.frontend and crash-looped the pod. Legacy Go EPP deployments keep their generated pool, config-file, and gRPC arguments (#16814).
v1alpha1 envFromSecret Preservation: Fixed DGDR overrides that set v1alpha1 envFromSecret on a service whose v1beta1 main container already had envFrom, such as hf-token-secret, which previously dropped the requested Secret during conversion. envFrom is now additive like env and volumeMounts, so the result matches the equivalent v1beta1 override (#16966).
GMS V1 Snapshot Loader Restart Loop: Fixed the gms-loader container exiting after a successful load with DYN_GMS_USE_V1=true, which made the restarted loader crash-loop and left the pod Ready=False (#16915).
Dynamo Sidecar
Dynamo Sidecar remains experimental in Dynamo v1.6.0.
vLLM Sidecar Parser Passthrough: Accepted --dyn-tool-call-parser and --dyn-reasoning-parser in the vLLM sidecar so the frontend parses output as in-process workers do (#15539), and started vLLM with --reasoning-parser none so thinking requests no longer returned 400 (#15684).
Sidecar Streaming Payload Fidelity: Fixed the vLLM sidecar to forward buffered empty text deltas as empty strings instead of dropping them, so the frontend waits for vLLM to release its stop-string buffer rather than detokenizing the token IDs and duplicating completion text (#14699), with corrected hidden stop-token reporting and preserved cancelled prefill responses (#15243).
Effective Attention Block Size: Fixed the vLLM sidecar to register and publish KV events with the engine-reported effective attention block size, so routing retains KV cache information under decode context parallelism (DCP) (#14673).
Decode Worker KV Indexing: Fixed the shared Rust worker forcing enable_local_indexer off for decode workers, so sidecars and other callers can create local KV indexes and recovery endpoints for declared event sources with matching model metadata. Explicit enable_local_indexer=false and the encode-role exclusion remain unchanged (#14981).
Early Sidecar Health Probes: Started sidecar health probes before waiting for the inference engine, so Kubernetes can pass the sidecar startup probe and launch the engine container while readiness stays independent of model loading (#15051).
SGLang Incremental Streaming Validation: Added a discovery check that rejects SGLang sidecar startup unless GetServerInfo reports incremental streaming output as enabled, with an error directing users to relaunch SGLang with --incremental-streaming-output. This prevents duplicated output and inflated completion-token counts caused by cumulative output IDs being treated as new tokens (#15150).
SGLang Sidecar Refusal Messages: Fixed SGLang sidecar request validation so refusals return their specific reason in the HTTP 400 response body instead of a generic "Invalid request" (#15285).
SGLang Cached Token Reporting: Fixed the SGLang sidecar to read cached_tokens from the engine's meta_info and report it as usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, clamped to the prompt length, so OpenAI completions and chat responses reflect prefix-cache hits instead of always reporting zero (#15602).
Guided Decoding for Tool Choice: Fixed TensorRT-LLM sidecar launch scripts, deploy examples, and the README engine command to set guided_decoding_backend: xgrammar, so chat completions requests with a required or named tool_choice return a parsed tool call instead of a 500 error (#15649).
Explicit Sidecar Launcher Resolution: Applied a shared resolve_sidecar helper across all 15 SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM sidecar launch scripts, so each prefers a native sidecar command and falls back to python3 -m dynamo.<backend>.sidecar (#16059).
Cancelled Sidecar Request Aborts: Fixed the vLLM native gRPC sidecar to abort cancelled requests, so queued requests are released instead of occupying an engine slot until output is produced (#16201).
TensorRT-LLM Sidecar Request Semantics: Fixed the TensorRT-LLM sidecar to forward conversation identity across prefill and decode, disable engine detokenization when Dynamo handles it, advertise the configured default thinking mode, and accept logical rank zero while still rejecting unsupported nonzero rank targeting, so conversation-scoped KV cache reuse works and valid rank-zero requests reach the engine (#16315).
Hybrid DP Rank Ownership: Fixed the vLLM sidecar so a frontend owning only part of a data parallel group, such as ranks 4 to 7 of an eight-rank group, is no longer rejected at discovery. Each worker now registers its local rank range (#14697).
SGLang
SGLang Cancellation Lifecycle Hardening: Added a bounded cancellation lifecycle for SGLang decode and aggregated workers that aborts requests cancelled before the first output token (#14781), extended it to disaggregated prefill workers and their paired decode-side state (#14782), and returned SGLang validation aborts as request errors before placeholder tokens or a successful finish could be emitted (#15065).
DCP Attention Backend Validation: Added a startup check that rejects --dcp-size on attention backends that do not read the DCP parallel state, where the SGLang worker would kill its scheduler (#14800), and extended it to MLA decode context parallel, suggesting --attention-backend flashinfer, trtllm_mla, or cutedsl_mla (#16255).
SGLang Guided Decoding Fix: Removed --skip-tokenizer-init from SGLang manifests and docs, because the flag caused response_format: json_schema requests to return content that did not satisfy the schema (#13605).
Disaggregated Parallel Sampling Rejection: Added validation that rejects SGLang disaggregated requests with n > 1 using an HTTP 400 error instead of letting them hang indefinitely. Aggregated parallel sampling and disaggregated n=1 requests continue to work (#14112).
SGLang API Compatibility Shims: Added compatibility shims for get_model_config and use_mla_backend, which SGLang moved from ServerArgs to its overrides module, fixing an AttributeError that prevented the SGLang worker from starting against newer SGLang versions (#14234).
Prefill DP Rank Forwarding: Fixed SGLang disaggregated serving so the Router forwards the prefill data-parallel rank to decode, dropping decode bootstrap_duration from 150 ms to 650 ms down to 0.3 ms to 0.6 ms on GLM-5.2 (#15246).
Prefill First-Token Logprobs: Fixed disaggregated prefill in SGLang to forward the generated-token logprobs option through the shared helper, so the first generated token now carries its log-probability data. Prompt-wide logprobs remain excluded because prefill discards that metadata and the Router does not merge it into the decode response (#15512).
Text-Only Engine Media Rejection: Added SGLang worker validation that returns a 400 error for image, video, or audio content on a text-only model, instead of silently dropping the media (#15520).
Attention-DP Rank Counting Fix: Fixed SGLang DP rank counting to match dp_size * attn_dp_size, so attention-DP workers register every rank instead of only rank 0 (#16598).
SGLang Crash Exit Delay: Fixed a 60-second delay in worker exit and pod restart after an SGLang child process died by defaulting SGLANG_CUDA_COREDUMP_BEFORE_CRASH_WAIT_SECS to 0 unless the user sets it, sets CUDA_ENABLE_USER_TRIGGERED_COREDUMP=1, or passes --crash-dump-folder. On one A100, worker exit after a killed detokenizer dropped from 66 seconds to 6 seconds (#16952).
TensorRT-LLM
Request-Local Pre-Submit Validation Errors: Fixed TensorRT-LLM handling of pre-submit ValueError, TypeError, and NotImplementedError failures so they return a request-scoped error instead of shutting down a healthy engine, while worker shutdown is preserved for unhealthy engines and errors raised during result iteration (#14006).
Decode Cached Token Reporting: Fixed usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens on the TensorRT-LLM generation-only path, which reported the transferred prompt as a cache hit, so benchmarks, dashboards, and routing decisions that read the usage block get accurate cache-hit data when return_perf_metrics is enabled (#15389).
Salted TensorRT-LLM Health Checks: Fixed TensorRT-LLM workers aborting when attention data parallelism and the V2 KV cache manager were enabled by giving the health-check probe request its own cache salt, so it no longer shares a reuse namespace with the engine's dummy requests. A caller-supplied salt still takes precedence (#16688).
MPI Child Failure Exit: Fixed TensorRT-LLM workers hanging until Kubernetes killed the container after an MPI engine child died. The worker now exits promptly with code 1 (#16931).
Snapshot Restore MPI Transport: Fixed restored TensorRT-LLM engines with TP greater than 1 failing their first collective with ucx send failed: Endpoint timeout. Snapshot mode now defaults OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1 and OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self, because Open MPI's UCX transport enables TCP keepalive probes that abort inter-rank connections during the checkpoint dump. Explicit settings still take precedence (#16941).
vLLM
ModelExpress RL Version Declaration: Reworked vLLM weight version reporting to report version: null with version_declared: false until declared, adding a set_weight_version route (#13041). Workers loading through the ModelExpress RL loader now declare MX_REFIT_DESIRED_VERSION_UID at startup (#15252).
Prefill Worker Lifecycle Hardening: Shut down EngineCore when a prefill worker exits and made FPM self-benchmark inputs reproducible with retained input, timing, execution, preparation, and worker provenance (#16789), with prefill health probes no longer requesting a KV connector handoff, which previously left unclaimed KV transfer state on idle prefill workers and blocked KV cache resets (#16825).
Elastic EP Grow Rollback: Fixed vLLM scale_elastic_ep so a failed grow rolls back to the previous data-parallel size and keeps serving instead of wedging the engine (#12991).
Engine-Expanded Prompt ID Metadata: Fixed vLLM nvext.engine_data to report the engine-processed prompt tokens, so training consumers can align them with completion tokens and log probabilities (#15470).
Model Loading & LoRA
LoRA Card Registration Fix: Fixed LoRA adapter registration in the SGLang and vLLM handlers by passing ignore_weights=True, so card registration no longer downloads base-model weights on a cache miss and fails before publishing the adapter (#11164).
Performance Modeling & Replay
Forward-Pass Metrics KV Warm-Up: Settled KV warm-up so decode sweeps no longer abort when attention-DP ranks report READY in different steps, with hybrid KDA/Mamba fixes (#14728, #14614). Snapshot-restored vLLM replicas now stay visible to the Planner (#12545).
Fault Tolerance & Observability
Request Trace Record Accuracy: Reworked audit records to derive payload_complete and payload_drop_reason from the actual response (#14143), and wrote request_end for requests cancelled before the first response item (#14799).
Histogram Bucket Configuration Fixes: Raised the default inter-token latency bucket ceiling from 2.0s to 80.0s (#14839).
Etcd and NATS Connection Resilience: Added etcd watch retry with backoff, enabled HTTP/2 keepalive by default with a 15s ping interval and 10s acknowledgment timeout, and raised the default lease TTL from 10s to 30s (#15266). Startup now retries temporary NATS connection failures for up to 120 seconds (#15269).
System Status Listener Rebinding: Fixed the system status server to rebind its TCP listener after accept failures instead of retrying a stale descriptor indefinitely, keeping status endpoints reachable after process restore while retaining the originally bound address, including an assigned ephemeral port (#12059).
Prefill Worker KV Gauges: Fixed missing dynamo_component_total_blocks and dynamo_component_gpu_cache_usage_percent samples on disaggregated vLLM prefill workers, which now publish configured total capacity at startup (#12559).
Pending Handshake Cancellation: Fixed requests hanging when a worker left discovery before sending the response prologue, so worker removal unblocks the requester with a migratable Disconnected error (#13095).
Worker Error Preservation: Fixed finish-reason handling in the backend so a worker's error finish reason is no longer overwritten by local stop detection, token limits, or user-defined stop strings, preventing failed requests from returning HTTP 200 with finish_reason: "stop" and malformed output (#15094).
Migration Handshake Cancellation Accounting: Fixed the Frontend to record client cancellation during a migration handshake as outcome="cancelled" instead of outcome="success" in dynamo_frontend_model_migration_duration_seconds, so migration metrics match the HTTP outcome for the same request (#16440).
Invalid Request Refusal Handling: Fixed worker routability after a worker refused an invalid request before opening the response stream, returning the worker's own error instead of wrapping it in CannotConnect. Clients now receive HTTP 400 and the worker stays routable rather than being marked down and causing HTTP 503 on the next valid request (#16597).
Runtime & Transport
IPv6-Only Networking Support: Reworked local address resolution to prefer non-loopback IPv4, then IPv6, then loopback (#13126), with the ZMQ event plane reusing it (#15324). Narrowed ZMQ_IPV6 to bracketed IPv6 endpoints, fixed remaining IPv6-only gaps in listeners, SGLang KV events, and vLLM multinode (#15383), and changed automatic host selection to prefer the routed source address (#15628).
QUIC Response Plane Reliability: Carried typed pre-stream errors through the QUIC response plane, mapping InvalidArgument to HTTP 400 (#14789), and updated Quinn to v0.11.12 to fix too many gaps in stream buffer failures (#14876).
Endpoint Identity-Scoped TCP Routing: Scoped TCP endpoint routing and cleanup by full endpoint identity, so endpoints registered under the same name in one process no longer overwrite or tear down each other's handlers (#14723, #14271).
Oversized TCP Frame Rejection: Added a preflight size check in the TCP client that rejects requests exceeding DYN_TCP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE before connection lookup and admission, returning InvalidArgument which the HTTP layer maps to a 400 response instead of letting the oversized frame reach the worker and close the connection during decode (#14110).
ZMQ Socket Exhaustion Guidance: Added error messages when event-plane socket creation fails with EMFILE, so operators hitting file-descriptor limits see advice to reduce direct-ZMQ peers or raise ulimit -n (#14145).
Shared Fetch Model Runtime: Fixed fetch_model() creating a second Tokio runtime when called before a Dynamo runtime existed, and the Python Worker mutating the process environment when applying transport overrides (#14534).
ZMQ Publisher Port Race: Fixed a race during concurrent ZMQ publisher startup by binding the publisher socket directly to an ephemeral port instead of probing with a temporary TCP listener, and read the assigned address back from the socket for logging and discovery, so concurrent publishers no longer collide on the same port (#14566).
Discovery Watch Establishment Ordering: Fixed discovery list-and-watch to return only after the backend watch is established, preventing missed Removed events (#14769). Every watch now opens with one Added event per matching instance and one Resync snapshot, so a reopened watch replaces state without a separate list call (#15143).
Container Images
Root Cache Mount Target: Fixed container/run.sh so that user overrides with a group suffix, such as --user root:root or 0:1000, mount the Hugging Face cache at /root/.cache/huggingface instead of the Dynamo user cache directory. Non-root users with group 0 continue to use the Dynamo user cache (#14820).

Operator Deployment Caveat Docs: Added a warning that compilationCache PVC contents must be cleared after a backend, torch, or CUDA upgrade (#14381), and documented that creating a DGDR carries the same authority as creating a Job or Pod in that namespace, while Pod-level security stays enforced by Pod Security Admission (#14429).
Snapshot API Documentation: Replaced the DynamoCheckpoint Auto mode wording with the SnapshotJob to PodSnapshot workflow (#16037), with a Kubernetes capture and restore quickstart including TensorRT-LLM examples for Qwen3-0.6B on one GPU and pinned GLM 5.3 NVFP4 on eight B200s (#16044).

Known Issues
Backend (SGLang)
Out-of-Vocab Stop Token Crash
A request whose stop_token_ids includes an ID at or above the model's vocabulary size can crash the SGLang scheduler when any request in the batch sets min_tokens, failing every request on that worker until it restarts. The issue also affects v1.5.0. No workaround is available yet.
Snapshot and GMS CUDA Graph Startup Failure
SGLang workers in Dynamo Snapshot mode or with GPU Memory Service V1 checkpointing fail at startup with a NotImplementedError from prefill CUDA graph initialization. The issue also affects v1.5.0. Workaround: pass --disable-cuda-graph to these workers.
Redundant Memory Resume Crash
With GPU Memory Service on SGLang, sending resume_memory_occupation twice without a release_memory_occupation in between crashes the scheduler. Workaround: send each resume only after a matching release.
Backend (TensorRT-LLM)
Oversized Anthropic Messages Return 500
On TensorRT-LLM, non-streaming /v1/messages requests whose prompt exceeds the engine's max_num_tokens return HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 400. No workaround is available yet.
Backend (vLLM)
Omitted Max Tokens Generates to the Context Limit
On vLLM, a request without max_tokens can generate up to the full remaining context window when the model sets no default output length. Workaround: set max_tokens on every request.
GMS Persisted KV Standby Wake Failure
With GPU Memory Service persisted KV failover (DYN_GMS_PERSIST_KV), tensor parallelism, and an explicit --kv-cache-memory-bytes, the vLLM standby engine fails to adopt the retained KV cache with StaleMemoryLayoutError. The issue also affects v1.5.0. Workaround: leave DYN_GMS_PERSIST_KV unset.
CLI & Tooling
Replay Module Entrypoint Removal
python -m dynamo.replay fails because the replay CLI moved into the AISimulate wheel in v1.5.0. Workaround: use aisimulate predict --stack dynamo --config <file>. See the replay guide.
Frontend
Logit Bias Ignored
The Frontend accepts logit_bias on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions but drops it before the engine, so no bias is applied. No workaround is available yet.
Request Error Details Dropped
When a worker rejects a request, the Frontend returns a generic error without the worker's message. The issue also affects v1.5.0. No workaround is available yet.
Planner
Inflated Capacity Estimate Suppresses Scaling
For aggregated vLLM deployments, a Dynamo Planner regression model seeded from worker self-benchmark data can overestimate per-engine capacity and refuse to scale up under load. Workaround: use a pre-published AISimulate performance model.
Runtime & Router
GlobalRouter Pool Requests Find No Endpoints
On Kubernetes with Grove, requests that the GlobalRouter sends to a pool can fail with no available endpoints even when the pool's worker is healthy. The issue also affects v1.5.0. No workaround is available yet.
Decode-Only Worker Pin Fails in Disaggregated Serving
A request that pins only a decode worker fails instead of letting the Router select a prefill worker. The issue also affects v1.5.0. Workaround: pin both workers with x-dynamo-worker-instance-id and x-dynamo-prefill-instance-id, or pin neither.
Kubernetes & Operator
Brief 404 Errors During Rolling Updates
Rolling updates of disaggregated deployments with a max surge of 1 and max unavailable of 0 can return HTTP 404 for up to about one second while a worker is replaced. The rollout still completes. The issue also affects v1.5.0. No workaround is available yet.
EFA Network Plugin Not Loaded
On AWS EFA clusters, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM workers configured from the EFA on AWS guide silently fall back to socket transport because the guide's LD_LIBRARY_PATH entry is wrong. The issue also affects v1.5.0. Workaround: use /opt/amazon/ofi-nccl/lib instead of /opt/aws-ofi-nccl/lib.
Reinforcement Learning
Slime Weight Synchronization Failure
With the experimental Slime integration, the first weight update from the Slime trainer to SGLang v0.5.21 engines fails with HTTP 400, and restarting the trainer against engines still running from an earlier job also fails. A fix is planned for a future release. No workaround is available yet.

The other v1.5.0 and v1.5.1 known issues are fixed in v1.6.0 or were closed as intended behavior.
Looking Ahead
Runtime Router Policy Management
A /router_policy API on the Frontend reads and updates live worker-selection parameters and busy thresholds without a restart.
Planner Reconfiguration & Batch Scheduling
Runtime reconfiguration extends beyond GPU budgets to a running Planner's SLA targets and load predictor. An opt-in batch scheduling policy reserves capacity for online traffic, with the Batch API served through the Frontend.
Generation Artifacts for RL
vLLM workers can deliver bounded generation artifacts inline or to object stores for reinforcement learning pipelines.
Kubernetes Deployment Search
An experimental v1beta2 API runs simulation-backed deployment searches, and DisaggregatedSet joins Grove as an opt-in workload provider.
